description: Get the current date and time in a specific IANA timezone (e.g. "America/New_York", "Europe/London", "Asia/Tokyo").
name: get_time_by_timezone

datetime.description: ISO 8601 datetime in the requested timezone

found.description: Present and true on an answer; a miss is the found:false branch.

oneOf.description: A miss or an unavailable upstream: found:false with a reason and a hint (the shape check-found-false-schemas.mjs expects).

title: Get Time By Timezone
